Module com.example.sudoku_game
Package com.example.sudoku_game.model

Class Music

java.lang.Object
com.example.sudoku_game.model.Music
All Implemented Interfaces:
IMusic
public class Music extends Object implements IMusic
Concrete implementation of the IMusic interface applying the Singleton Design Pattern. This class acts as the centralized audio manager for the entire application, ensuring that only a single audio stream tracks playback at any given time to avoid overlapping audio channels, while safely disposing of low-level multimedia resources during view transitions.

  • Method Details

    • getInstance

      public static Music getInstance()
      Returns the single shared instance of Music. If no instance exists yet, one is created. This ensures only one audio manager is active throughout the application lifecycle.
      Returns:
      the singleton Music instance.

    • playLoop

      public void playLoop(String fileName)
      Loads and plays an audio file in an infinite loop at a reduced volume. Before playing, any currently active audio is stopped and disposed of to prevent overlapping playback. The audio file is loaded from the application's /Sounds/ resource folder.
      Specified by:
      playLoop in interface IMusic
      Parameters:
      fileName - the name of the audio file to play (e.g., "background.mp3"). The file must exist under /com/example/sudoku_game/Sounds/.

    • stopAndDispose

      public void stopAndDispose()
      Stops the current audio playback and releases all associated resources. This method should be called before loading a new audio track or when navigating between views to avoid memory leaks and audio conflicts. If no audio is currently playing, this method has no effect.
      Specified by:
      stopAndDispose in interface IMusic
